content.title: The Magic of Modularity
content.abstract: How can a large organisation avoid bureaucracy and stagnation? How can a company increase its rate of innovation? The answer to both questions is to unlock the magic of modularity. W. Ross Ashby, the British cyberneticist, argued that ‘when the complexity of the environment exceeds the capacity of a system, the environment will ultimately destroy that system’. Bureaucracies stagnate because while centralisation and standardisation increases efficiency, they also inadvertently reduce a system’s capacity to innovate and to respond.
